integrity: Proof uses a fully specified finite acyclic simplicial matching and an exact signed integral attaching vector, independently corroborated by small Alexander-dual field ranks. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the ordinary three-cut complex of the 5-regular sixteen-vertex Clebsch graph only. No claim about the complement, other cut parameters, equivariant homotopy, other graph orders or uniqueness in the literature.
title: Integral two-torsion in the Clebsch graph's ordinary three-cut complex
